explanation.headline: Phenytoin sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale Lakeside holds 13.2 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include phenytoin sodium as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 165 capsules of the 100 mg presentation, providing 21.5 days on hand at 7.7 capsules per day.
Corvale General holds 253 capsules, providing 30.6 days on hand at 8.3 capsules per day.
Corvale Lakeside holds 23 capsules, providing 13.2 days on hand at 1.7 capsules per day.
The label for NDC 50090353900 names A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-08-12.
A-S Medication Solutions received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05 and its most recent inspection was classified VAI on 2026-08-12.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.
